item.title: USNI News Fleet and Marine Tracker: Sept. 14, 2026
item.description: These are the approximate positions of the U.S. Navy's deployed carrier strike groups and amphibious ready groups throughout the world as of Sept. 14, 2026, based on Navy and public data. USS Gerald R. Ford (CVN-78) is operating in the Eastern Mediterranean following a port visit to Souda Bay. USS Harry S. Truman (CVN-75) is in the North Arabian Sea supporting CENTCOM operations; the strike group transited the Strait of Hormuz earlier in the week at approximately 26.57N 56.25E. USS Carl Vinson (CVN-70) departed San Diego and is in the Philippine Sea near 20°N 135°E. USS Bataan (LHD-5) and USS San Antonio (LPD-17) are operating in the Persian Gulf. The Abraham Lincoln Carrier Strike Group remains in the Western Pacific. USS Makin Island (LHD-8) is in the Red Sea north of Bab el-Mandeb.

item.title: Destroyer conducts Taiwan Strait transit
item.description: USS Higgins (DDG-76) conducted a routine transit of the Taiwan Strait on Saturday, the 7th Fleet said in a statement. The guided-missile destroyer is forward-deployed to Yokosuka. Separately, an SSN-774 class attack submarine arrived at Apra Harbor, Guam, and USS Canberra (LCS-30) departed Singapore.

item.title: Amphibious ready group completes Mediterranean patrol
item.description: The Bataan Amphibious Ready Group completed a scheduled patrol in the Mediterranean Sea and is expected to transit the Suez Canal into the Red Sea next week. The ARG includes USS Bataan (LHD-5), USS Mesa Verde (LPD-19) and USS Carter Hall (LSD-50). The 26th Marine Expeditionary Unit is embarked.
